children: Ollie’s Bargain Outlet reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 net sales of $741.3 million and net income of $85.5 million, with adjusted diluted earnings per share of $1.42. Revenue rose 9.1% year-over-year while comparable store sales declined 1.8%. The company opened 15 new stores in the quarter and updated its full-year guidance, including reinvestment of IEEPA tariff refunds into pricing.
Net sales: $741.3 million for the thirteen weeks ended August 1, 2026 (up 9.1% year-over-year).
Gross profit: $322.2 million; gross margin 43.5% of net sales for the quarter.
Operating income: $108.5 million for the quarter.
Net income: $85.5 million for the quarter; net income per diluted share: $1.42.
Adjusted EBITDA: $127.1 million for the quarter; adjusted net income per diluted share: $1.42.
Store growth: opened 15 new stores and closed one storm-damaged store, ending the quarter with 686 stores across 36 states (11.9% year-over-year increase).
Customer loyalty: Ollie’s Army membership grew 12.7% to 18.1 million members.
Comparable store sales: declined 1.8% versus a 5.0% increase in the prior-year quarter, driven by a decrease in average basket size.

Supply chain and pricing actions: gross margin benefited from lower supply chain costs, including IEEPA tariff refunds which contributed 380 basis points to gross margin in the quarter; the company intends to reinvest $28.3 million of refunds into pricing to strengthen competitiveness.
Capital allocation: repurchased $84.0 million of common stock in the quarter (1.107 million shares); approximately $121.5 million remained available under the repurchase authorization at quarter end.
